# 1. Introduction & Motivation

La desnormalizacion de las otras practicas y otras transformaciones
```{r intro}
library(randomForest)
library(pdp)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(dplyr)

bikes_df <- read.csv("day.csv")
bikes <- bikes_df %>% mutate(days_since_2011 = as.numeric(instant - 1), 
    temp = as.numeric(temp * 47 - 8), hum = as.numeric(hum * 100),
    windspeed = as.numeric(windspeed * 67),
    weathersit = factor(weathersit, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), 
                        labels = c("GOOD", "MISTY", "RAIN", "HEAVY RAIN"))) %>%
  select(cnt, days_since_2011, temp, hum, windspeed, workingday, holiday, season, weathersit)
```
